I farm this small piece of land same way my father did. For yam and cassava, I put the heaps and plant the cuttings I save from last harvest — I do not buy seed from agro-dealer, that one is for those who plant maize. I cannot spend money on fertilizer bag for tubers, the bag is too big for this small plot and I hear it makes the yam rot in storage. I will put the goat droppings and the rubbish from the compound on the heaps before planting, that one I have always done. My sons and my wife will help me clear, make heaps, and weed — that is plenty work but we manage. Maybe I call one or two people to help me make the heaps when the rain start, I give them food and small money.
